mr_description:
This fixes a bug introduced in where `toPromise` was used. This
doesn't work in all situations here because some observables don't
complete. This only affected the redirect path, since the others are
already behind other rxjs code which takes the first value from the user
guards.

Note: This is marked as a refactor rather than fix because the commit above is not in
any release yet.

expected_issues.title: first() rejects empty observables that used to fall through to the next route
expected_issues.description:
The new firstValueFrom helper uses first(), which errors with EmptyError when the observable completes without emitting; callers in recognize.ts only treat NoMatch errors as 'try next route', so an empty guard/matcher observable now aborts navigation.

toPromise() resolved with undefined for an empty observable; first() rejects with EmptyError. matchWithChecks() and canLoad/canMatch guard pipelines can legitimately complete without a value (e.g. a guard returning EMPTY), which previously led the recognizer to move on. With this helper the navigation fails with an unexpected error. EmptyError must be handled (treated as no match) or the helper must resolve on completion.
